name: Telegram
refreshNote: Send the URL (up to 10 links per message) to the official @WebpageBot (https://t.me/WebpageBot) in Telegram; it re-fetches and updates the cached preview for future shares. Already-sent messages keep their old preview.
notes: Telegram has no official public documentation of its link-preview parser; field fallbacks, the large/small image rule and image sizes here come from secondary sources (opengraphplus.com, ogpreview.app, enterno.io) and are estimates.

Large vs small rule (secondary sources): twitter:card=summary_large_image shows the image full width; 'summary' or a missing twitter:card shows a small thumbnail at the right of the text even for a 1200x630 image. Some reports also tie large media to image size; treat as uncertain.

Since the Dec 2023 'Replies 2.0, Adjustable Link Previews' update, the sender can choose larger/smaller media and preview above/below the text (Bot API LinkPreviewOptions.prefer_large_media / prefer_small_media / show_above_text), so the final size is partly user-controlled.

Layout: site name (accent colour, bold) / title (bold) / description, inside a coloured left-bar block. Title and description wrap over several lines rather than a fixed character cut; truncation set to null (unknown).
Image minimum 200x200 and 1200x630 recommendation are secondary-source estimates; no documented max bytes (null). SVG not rendered (estimate); webp believed to work (estimate).
Pages with an Instant View template show an 'Instant View' button; that is configured via instantview.telegram.org templates, not meta tags.

Verification method: official doc pages were located via web search (search-engine extracts of the official URLs listed in source); direct page fetches of the official domain were blocked from the research environment, so wording could not be re-read in full.
